data.name: Faith
data.description: Your belief in a higher power fuels your psychic abilities. Whether your mental abilities truly come to you as a divine gift or are simply enhanced by the power of your belief, none can say. In many ways, you resemble a divine caster, and prayers often factor into your casting of psychic spells. Phrenic Pool Ability: Wisdom. Discipline Powers: Your powers serve to protect or cure you and your allies.
